en: So, another challenger slips past Will. I am Koga of the Elite Four, master of the ninja's arts.
My poisons do not strike all at once. They wear the strongest down a little at a time.
Confusion, sleep and venom... Let us see how long your Pokémon last!
Ah! You have proven your worth in full.
Go on. The next of us is waiting, and he fights with nothing but his fists.
A ninja learns most from the battles he loses. I shall train in the dark a while longer.
